rounds: On holiday, I’d rather eat somewhere local than at a chain I already know.
Global brands make every city look the same.
A logo should look exactly the same in every country.
Cartoons from other countries are better for children than cartoons from home.
I would rather buy from a local brand than a global one.
A really good design works everywhere without any changes.
Designers should only design for cultures they know well.
Christmas markets outside Germany are never as good as the ones at home.
